title: Movement
description: Smoother creature and player movement against the CustomDM server: no back-slide after a sticky, no stuck slide after a collision, a blended stop at arrival, and run speed that changes live. The edits depend on each other in this order: the crossfade rewrites a call inside the arrival cave, the live player speed hooks into the run rate cave, and the blend into the live speed caves. Needs the code-space and animation-break entries.

items.change: A creature stuck to its target forgets the positions queued before the sticky, so it no longer runs back through them when the sticky ends (back-slides of 2 to 7 m)

edits.note: StickyManager::StickTo: the call to set_target jumps to a cave
cave: the same set_target call, then CPhysicsObj::StopInterpolating on the sticky's physics object ([esi+50h]), back to 0x556396

items.change: A step that collides with something no longer leaves the stored sliding normal behind, so a chaser that ran into its target is not stuck for seconds

edits.note: CPhysicsObj::UpdateObjectInternal, branch where transition() returned null: the call to set_frame goes to a cave
cave: and dword ptr [esi+0ACh],0FFFFFFFBh (clears the SLIDING bit of transient_state), then jmp CPhysicsObj::set_frame

items.change: A creature that arrives at its target after a chase drops its queued link animations, so it does not glide on past the arrival point (players are left alone)

edits.note: MoveToManager::HandleMoveToPosition, arrival branch: the call to _StopMotion goes to a cave

cave (entered by a call, so it first copies the caller's two arguments): _StopMotion; then for a move to an object (type 6) of a non-player (weenie bit 8 of +100h clear) CPhysicsObj::RemoveLinkAnimations

items.change: The pose change at a chase arrival is blended over ten updates instead of snapping

edits.note: CPartArray::UpdateParts: the call to Frame::combine goes to CaveC
the call to RemoveLinkAnimations in the arrival cave goes to CaveB

CaveB registers the creature's CPartArray in an 8-slot table at 0x906800 (10 updates left) and jumps to RemoveLinkAnimations; CaveC combines as before, then blends the new pose (nlerp of origin and quaternion) with the old one, the old pose weighing 0.07 per remaining update (0.70 falling to 0.07)

items.change: A change of the player's run rate while a run key or autorun is held (spell, road bonus, burden, exhaustion) takes effect at once, without releasing the keys

edits.note: CommandInterpreter::UseTime, first instructions: jmp to cave F (the stolen instructions run there)

cave F: reads the run rate as CMotionInterp::apply_run_to_command does, compares its bits with the last one seen (dword 0x906FE0) and when it changed re-issues the held command through ApplyCurrentMovement (0x6B4370), unless the server controls the player, motions are pending or a move-to runs

items.change: A creature running to its target changes speed or walk/run without stopping when the server sends the move again with the speed-update flag (0x800 in the first word of the packet)

edits.note: MovementManager::unpack_movement, hook A: skips cancel_moveto and unstick_from_object for a flagged move-to packet while the creature runs to its target (flag byte 0x906FE4)
unpack_movement, hook B1 after the run rate of MoveToObject is stored
unpack_movement, hook B2, the same place for MoveToPosition
cave A
cave B1: when the flag is set, clears it and calls MoveToManager::BeginMoveForward (0x52A610), which retimes the run through CMotionTable::GetObjectSequence without a stop
cave B2

items.change: A live speed change that switches the creature's forward command (snare: run to walk and back) is blended with the same crossfade

edits.note: cave B1: the call to BeginMoveForward goes to the wrapper W
cave B2: the call to BeginMoveForward goes to the wrapper W
cave R registers the creature's CPartArray in the crossfade table (as CaveB); wrapper W calls R with the creature's physics object, then jumps to BeginMoveForward

items.change: The player's own run speed changes during a server move-to (/god, Sprint) without stopping: the run is re-issued when the rate the client computes changes

edits.note: cave F, at the point where the new rate is stored: jumps to cave G
cave G: if the player's MoveToManager runs a MoveToObject or MoveToPosition with WalkForward or RunForward, calls BeginMoveForward, which re-issues the command at the rate InqRunRate returns now
